definitions.gloss: freshly baked; freshly grilled; just out of the oven
definitions.explanation: Describes bread, pastries, or grilled items that have just been cooked and are still hot. Often used as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

examples.english: At this shop, you can always buy freshly baked cookies.

notes:
FORMS:
Formed from ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (to bake/grill) + たて (just done). The suffix たて attaches to the conjunctive form of verbs to mean "just [verb]ed" or "freshly [verb]ed."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (freshly baked bread)
- {焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧ (freshly baked cookies)
- {焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (freshly grilled fish)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧: freshly fried
- {炊|た}きたて: freshly cooked (rice)
- {出来|でき}たて: freshly made
